scope: Original evaluator, original arithmetic/rounding helpers and original UV setter. Only critical-section boundaries are intercepted. Original sine table bytes retained. Sequential updates compare every UV offset and shared time.
mode128: All44 authored mode128 records are members with layer handle0. The original evaluator takes its default branch and writes zero to that axis; no special oscillation or flag masking occurs.
limits: Authored membership lists are decoded, but live creation/destruction and global frame scheduling remain game state.

Eight original-wrapper cases also verify scaled primary time, unscaled secondary time and the one-shot zeroing of offsets for registered scenes whose header+0x158 is nonzero. Live scheduling of that request remains separate.
